description:
Make everyday trips more enjoyable with the EOEOTWO GT05 electric scooter for adults. A 1000W motor, 48V 13Ah battery, and front and rear suspension bring power and comfort to your commute, neighborhood errands, and weekend rides.

1000W Power with Three Speed Modes
Reach speeds of up to 29 MPH, with three speed settings of approximately 4, 16, and 29 MPH. Choose a setting that suits your surroundings, whether you’re taking a relaxed neighborhood ride or traveling along a longer permitted route.

Up to Approximately 25 Miles per Charge
The 48V 13Ah battery delivers 624Wh of capacity and a stated range of approximately 18.6–24.9 miles. From your morning commute to an afternoon coffee stop, the GT05 helps you cover everyday trips with fewer charging stops. Recharge in approximately 3–4 hours with the included US charger.

10-Inch Tires and Front & Rear Suspension
Navigate uneven pavement with 10-inch tubeless off-road tires and front and rear spring suspension. Together, they help soften bumps for a more comfortable ride across changing surfaces.

Dual Disc Brakes and Integrated Lighting
Front and rear disc brakes provide controlled stopping, while a six-lens headlight helps illuminate your route. A rear light with integrated turn signals and a built-in horn help you communicate with others around you.

A Spacious Platform for Everyday Riding
The approximately 19.7 × 7.1-inch deck features a slip-resistant silicone surface, giving you room to adjust your stance. An aluminum-alloy and steel frame supports a maximum load of approximately 330 lb.

Fold, Store, and Get Going
A one-step folding design makes it easier to store the GT05 between rides. The large LED display keeps ride information easy to read, and a keyed lock adds everyday convenience. The scooter weighs approximately 58.3 lb.

What’s Included
GT05 electric scooter, US 3A charger, two pairs of brake pads, tool kit, user manual, and moisture-absorbing packet.

Actual speed and range vary with rider weight, terrain, riding mode, temperature, and battery condition. Charging time varies with battery level and conditions. Follow local riding rules and wear a helmet.
